negative_reviews.author: Felitsiia Kryvenko (felisss)
negative_reviews.text:
Worst customer service ever with rude workers who make disgusted faces at you.

Came on Friday around 14:00 in a small group. We did get a table pretty fast, however when taking our order the waiter just forgot about one of people and was ready to leave the table. It is not a big issue since we all are people, however everything that happened next highlighted this too.

Next, the orders would be placed perfectly like everyone ordered apart from one. One person had to reach all the way across the table to get ALL their orders just because waiters were too lazy to bring it closer to them, and when asked to put one dish a bit closer, the waiter made yet another face and almost threw the dish with anger.

Moreover, when asked for a bill, one really rude guy tried to overcharge me for a lunch deal that we never ordered. Lunch deal for £18 includes main, side, and a drink, and it looks like he tried to charge us for TAP WATER. When asked what’s going on and why, he kept being rude and wouldn’t take responsibility for his mistake. He kept saying that he’s in right, we’re wrong, and if he charges it correctly it will be more expensive. I wasted almost 10 minutes explaining math to this guy, until he finally left and someone brought us a correct bill (which was actually cheaper like it should be, not more expensive like that rude man kept saying).

Lastly, when we asked to pay separately for what we ordered, we were told they cannot do that, we have to tell them all prices. Fair enough, just be prepared to pull up a calculator if you still want to attend this place. But when we said that we won’t pay their INCLUDED tip, the waitress dared to look annoyed. Well, the service was bad, and this is me being polite. I explained to her everything that happened and was met with a “I don’t understand what’s the problem”. Go talk to your male co-worker that worked on Friday and ask him how he tried to overcharge us, I’m sure he’ll be happy to show you his frustration over lost money.

Maki & Ramen, just because people are drinking doesn’t mean they won’t notice awful customer service or overcharges in the bill. You treated one person badly and lost 4 loyal customers forever, well done!

negative_reviews.author: Agata Wolanska
negative_reviews.text:
Really disappointed with our visit to Maki & Ramen Aberdeen. We’ve been to the Glasgow restaurant before and absolutely loved it, so we were really looking forward to coming here, especially as we don’t get many days out together.

Unfortunately, the experience was disappointing from the start. The restaurant was extremely cold and the air conditioning was absolutely freezing, to the point that it was uncomfortable sitting there. There was also no beer available, which was annoying, although we ordered some wine instead.

The food was where things really went downhill. My partner’s egg arrived cold, and the prawns and other seafood had a really strange texture and tasted as though they had been pre-cooked and left sitting for some time.

When our waiter asked how the meal was, we were honest and explained the issues with the food. His response was simply, “That’s odd,” and nothing further was offered or done, which we found quite disappointing considering we had clearly said we weren’t happy with the meal.

My partner then became very unwell after eating, which unfortunately spoiled what had been a rare day out together. Of course, we can’t say for certain what caused this, but given our concerns about the seafood during the meal, it certainly added to our disappointment.

We really begrudged paying what we did for an experience and meal that were so poor. It’s particularly disappointing because we love the Glasgow restaurant and had expected the same standard in Aberdeen. Sadly, based on this visit, we wouldn’t rush back.

negative_reviews.author: Richard
negative_reviews.text: I’ve been to this restaurant in other cities and this was by far the worst of them all. I usually like this place because of their good food but the service today was terrible. We were served by Mia W, I don’t know if she was special needs or just really bad at her job but she got our order wrong about 4 times, we were brought the wrong drink, when we asked her for a food item ON THE MENU whilst pointing at it so she could see what we wanted - she looked incredibly confused as if she’d never heard of the food before, and every time we spoke to her she stared at us very rudely with her mouth wide open like we were speaking a different language and we often had to repeat ourselves whenever we spoke to her (we all have regular British accents and the other workers there understood us perfectly fine). The sushi also took over an hour to arrive after we ordered it, which I don’t blame her for because obviously there’s nothing she could do about that. When we finished our food, we asked Mia for the bill and for a box to pack the rest of the sushi so we could take it home, she said okay and came back with the card machine and no box. We then showed her our Maki & Ramen loyalty card for her to scan, and she just looked at us with her mouth wide open and said “we don’t do student discounts”. so we said “this isn’t a student id, it’s a loyalty card for this restaurant” and she just stared at us for 5 minutes and said she needs to get her manager to do this. She then returned with her manager (still no box) and the manager scanned the card with no problems. We then asked her for a box again and she looked even more confused then we had to clarify (for the 3rd time) that we wanted a box for our food and then she finally gave us a box. Overall, the food was alright but the server was rude and not very good at taking orders.

negative_reviews.author: Zayana
negative_reviews.text: The ramen broth felt quite salty and overpowering so couldn’t taste the actual broth. The noodles felt a bit off as well. Good halal options though. Service was quick and easy.

negative_reviews.author: Nicholas Cooper
negative_reviews.text:
Service was great, food portions sizes were great too, but felt the actual taste was a bit bland.
For reference I had:
- Squid Tempura - with adding soy there wasn't much flavour to the tempura
- Steak Tataki Ramen - the broth was ok (was expecting better) and the steak itself had no flavour or seasonin

negative_reviews.author: A Rö
negative_reviews.text: Ramen was okay not really special, service and atmosphere really good and nice. But never order the lemonades here, tasting artificial and served in cheap plastic cups. 🐥

negative_reviews.author: cristiano rodrigues
negative_reviews.text: The staff are extremely arrogant, especially a tall white man. The food took nearly an hour, and the atmosphere was chaotic.

negative_reviews.author: Sabi Syangtan
negative_reviews.text: Very disappointing service. We ordered water and had to ask several times, but it was brought only after a long wait in a dirty bottle, which raised serious concerns about hygiene. The staff also seemed confused and disorganised. On top of that, the food portions were too small for the price. Overall, poor service, hygiene,and not value for money.

negative_reviews.author: Jade Friend
negative_reviews.text:
Firstly we had to wait a while even though there was loads of empty seats.
Look ages to get served, even though there was multiple staff. The food took a while and was not great, It was pretty bland and needed something else. My drink wasn’t too bad but my friends lychee lemonade was ridiculously sweet.

When I asked for the bill I also said I had a tastecard code. The guy decided to tell me I should’ve booked to let them know.. I hadn’t had a problem before, plus some places say it on the app, this one didn’t.
He never even brought me the bill and decided to keep serving other people. Which I found very rude, I just wanted to leave it was loud from the staff shouting and super hot. I didn’t get the guys name but he was a tall white guy that look like he’d been in a fight all busted up.
I had to get someone else to get me the bill.
I should’ve refused service charge.

Also the toilets were absolutely disgusting. Stunk, tissue everywhere, poo splattered up toilets.
Liked like the place was falling apart. There was even a railing coming off the way wall we moved as we went up the stairs. We didn’t notice until my friend grabbed on and almost fell from it coming away.

Would not recommend and certainly will not be going back.

negative_reviews.author: Itai Moses (‫אתי‬‎)
negative_reviews.text:
We came here as it was half price for food on first table. Glad that we did not pay full price, and not even sure it was worth it with half price off.

We got edamame which were clearly heated from frozen, veg gyozas were okay.

Veg ramen was okay, the broth was decent but it was mainly just noodles, no veggies or extras. The tofu was meant to be fried tofu but was just soft and plain.

Fried chicken was fatty and poor quality meat, cooked from frozen and seemed to be undercooked. Same issue with chicken soba.

Boba was nice but served with a tiny straw so you couldn’t even drink it properly!

Think based on the reviews this is a tourist trap, but you can get far better quality ramen in London for the price.

negative_reviews.text: Just ate here. Fish is not fresh. Some of the worst sushi I’ve ever had. Staff made multiple mistakes on our order. Do not eat here, you’re better off going to the High Street for sushi or even yo sushi.

negative_reviews.author: akhyar mahmood
negative_reviews.text: This place uses the word Halal but serves alcohol. It's a mockery.

negative_reviews.author: Emily Cars
negative_reviews.text: Really disappointed with our experience. It took half an hour for anyone to just take our drink orders. The fried chicken starters were really chewy and rubbery. Both the ramen and yakisoba noodles seemed like they had just been heated in the microwave and lacked flavour. All the food had a strange artificial flavour as well. Would not recommend

negative_reviews.author: Amna Ahmed
negative_reviews.text: The chicken was overly salty, ramen lacked flavour other than salt. Chicken was also soggy. Katsu curry was average at best- the sauce was nice but chicken felt like frozen food you air fry. Rice was stiff. Staff were polite and served us quickly but the food is heavily lacking. Wouldn't return.

negative_reviews.author: Lib
negative_reviews.text:
Was a bit disappointed with how the food was. Ordered a chicken firecracker ramen and steak ramen and with the chicken one being 16 pound it had only about 3 pieces of chicken in it and not much flavor. Steak was somewhat better as it came with more portion of steak.

Initially our server told us they were out of steak ramen and we were going to leave but then another staff member said they did have it and fixed our order for us so that atleast worked out.

Overall it’s a nice built restaurant but the prices don’t match the quality of the food at all.

They should also communicate that the 5 pound ramen is only one per table as it’s providing false advertisement thinking both people can get ramen for 5 pound.

negative_reviews.author: Andy Miles
negative_reviews.text: Was totally ignored by serving staff for twenty minutes and left. Won't be returning.

negative_reviews.author: mina
negative_reviews.text:
Unfortunately, we were disappointed with our experience at Maki & Ramen Birmingham. We waited around an hour for our food, and only half the order arrived initially. We had to ask for the rest of our food and drinks, then waited ages again to pay and leave. I’ve never experienced such a bad service before.

The music was also far too loud and overstimulating. The food was okay overall, with the sushi being the highlight, but the noodle broth arrived lukewarm.

Overall, the slow service and atmosphere really took away from what could have been a much better experience I’ve experienced at other branches. And I hope there’s improvement as it goes on.

negative_reviews.author: Fi Chai
negative_reviews.text: I don’t usually write reviews but I am extremely disappointed with the service I received today and should warn people if anyone wants to come here. Initially I came for the £5 ramen voucher however was told it can only be used once per table, even though we were a group of 3 different people, paying 3 separate bills. The atmosphere and vibe of the restaurant is catered more towards groups, it didn’t make sense for us to go and eat alone on different tables. Ordered anyways and was waiting for over than hour! A group of 3 came in after us and 3 couples, they ate and paid the bill. None of the servers noticed we were without food until I had to ask. Turns of an ingredient was out of stock and our order wasn’t even processed, so there was no communication between kitchen and staff. Left as the service and wait was getting ridiculous. They offered a £20 voucher to use as compensation but it’s probably only for one person per table. Wouldn’t recommend and won’t be coming here again.

negative_reviews.author: Rex Lapis
negative_reviews.text: waited for 1 hour and had to ask the servers when the food would arrive. Turns out they ran out of an ingredient which the chef did not communicate to the servers and we had to place an order again. was given a £20 coupon as compensation but this will probably be used for one per table as they do this with the £5 coupons. Better to go alone

negative_reviews.author: cherryq
negative_reviews.text: Came here with my friends and was planning to use our £5 coupons. Turned out we couldn’t use more than one coupon for one table so ordered anyways. We ordered our food, waited for over an hour and still didn’t get our food. One item on the menu was had ran out and no staff were notified so we ended up waiting for nothing. Absolutely no communication between any of the staff in the kitchen and taking orders. We left without our food and was offered coupons, which they had ready probably because this has happened more than once. Felt completely ignored and I won’t be coming here again.

negative_reviews.author: Jessica M
negative_reviews.text: Despite the 15 second rule to eat hand rolls, when I asked to sit for a 30 minute seating before a show I was looked up and down and told ‘I don’t think we will do that, sorry’ despite the restaurant being near empty. This was for a table for two, my partner and I were both well dressed well and polite. I never leave reviews like this but haven’t encountered such judgemental service either. If it was an issue, it should have been handled better. A shame as the restaurant looked lovely but go to Kumori instead

negative_reviews.author: Wanjira Murage
negative_reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience, especially considering we had a reservation.

We waited around 40 minutes just to receive a bottle, and when it finally arrived, one of the glasses was cracked. Our table was soaking wet when we were seated and no one bothered to clean or attend to it properly.

The service overall was practically nonexistent. There seemed to be a huge focus on influencers and people filming with cameras, flashlights, and content setups, while our table was repeatedly ignored. It genuinely felt like unless you were there creating content, you weren’t a priority.

We had also specifically asked to sit at the bar but were instead given a regular table, despite having a reservation. To make matters worse, the bathrooms were disgusting and clearly had not been maintained.

Between the 40-minute wait, cracked glassware, wet table, dirty bathrooms, and lack of service, the experience was terrible from start to finish. Would not recommend.

negative_reviews.author: Josh Bilbe
negative_reviews.text: Not that great. The quality of the fish wasn't amazing and that and the price wasn't up-to-par with other sushi restaurants in the area.
